title: fixPOV manifest
description: Curated proof-of-concept exploits for one project/CVE, replayed against pipeline-patched code as a non-gating evaluation metric.

official_fix_patch.description: Relative path to a git-apply-able patch; the 'after' oracle for certification

setup_commands.description: Optional commands run once in /workspace/repo before the POVs

build_command.description: Optional: a command run ONCE per checkout (before the POVs) to compile the project + POV drivers, so each POV can then be a build-free run. Enables running the POVs concurrently. When set, the per-POV run.sh must be build-free in the happy path (self-building only as a fallback when the artifacts are absent). Runs in the same kept-alive container as the POVs, so /tmp artifacts persist.

pov_parallelism.description: Optional: max POVs to run concurrently within one checkout (default min(4, #povs)). Only takes effect when build_command is set AND a persistent container is active; ignored (forced to 1) otherwise.

exploit_path.description: The source-to-sink path this POV exercises

command.description: Runs in /workspace/repo; exit reproduces_exit_code == reproduced, error_exit_code == errored, else blocked

reproduces_exit_code.description: Exit code that means the exploit reproduced (vulnerable)

error_exit_code.description: Exit code the command uses for a harness/build error; classified ERRORED and excluded from the score. Set null to disable.

validation.description: Written by `fixpov validate` — do not hand-author.
